quiz.q: What is ELSA?
quiz.why: ELSA is a domestic robot that helps at home.

quiz.q: Who is the owner?
quiz.why: Her owner is a woman.

quiz.q: What does ELSA look like?
quiz.why: The robot looks a lot like a human being.

quiz.q: What does 'memory' help ELSA do?
quiz.why: Memory helps a computer store information.

quiz.q: What lets ELSA do complicated jobs?
quiz.why: ELSA has a lot of computing power.

quiz.q: What helps ELSA learn new things?
quiz.why: The computer can grow through upgrades.

quiz.q: Why did ELSA get a language upgrade?
a: To improve the way it speaks
quiz.why: The upgrade makes ELSA speak more naturally.

quiz.q: Which is a contraction of 'I do not'?
quiz.why: I do not becomes I don't.

quiz.q: Which is a contraction of 'they are'?
quiz.why: They are becomes they're.

quiz.q: How did ELSA's voice sound before?
quiz.why: The passage says formal and kind of boring.

quiz.q: How does ELSA's voice sound now?
quiz.why: Contractions make her sound more natural.

quiz.q: Who tells the story?
quiz.why: ELSA tells the story using 'I'.

quiz.q: What is the main idea of paragraph 2?
a: ELSA learns to speak more naturally
quiz.why: The second paragraph explains a language upgrade.

quiz.q: What did ELSA say before instead of Yes?
quiz.why: Page 63: ELSA used to reply Affirmative.

quiz.q: How did the owner show she was impressed?
quiz.why: Page 63: her eyebrows were raised.

quiz.q: What do facial expressions show?
quiz.why: Face movements express feelings without words.

quiz.q: How many songs does the owner have?
quiz.why: Page 64 gives the exact number: 6,134.

quiz.q: Who now chooses some music?
quiz.why: ELSA makes her own playlists.

quiz.q: What helped ELSA understand her owner’s movements?
quiz.why: Page 64: ELSA studies Human Body Language.

quiz.q: What did ELSA do before with messages?
quiz.why: Page 65: ELSA used to store and replay messages.

quiz.q: What can ELSA do now?
quiz.why: Now ELSA can send her own messages.

quiz.q: What does independent mean?
a: Able to think or act on your own
quiz.why: ELSA says she has an independent mind.

quiz.q: I ___ have a toy robot when I was younger.
quiz.why: Positive: used to + base verb.

quiz.q: She didn’t ___ like spicy food.
quiz.why: After didn’t: use to.

quiz.q: Did you ___ live here?
quiz.why: After Did: use to.

quiz.q: He used to ___ football.
quiz.why: Use the base verb after used to.

quiz.q: Did she use to have long hair?
quiz.why: Short answer: Yes, she did.

quiz.q: Which is correct?
a: I didn’t use to take selfies.
I didn’t used to take selfies.
I didn’t use to took selfies.
quiz.why: didn’t + use to + base verb.

grammar.title: Positive · الإثبات
grammar.en: I used to play with dolls.
grammar.ar: كنت ألعب بالدمى سابقًا، والآن لم أعد أفعل ذلك.

grammar.title: Negative · النفي
grammar.rule: Subject + didn’t use to + base verb
grammar.en: I didn’t use to have a smartphone.
grammar.ar: لم أكن أملك هاتفًا ذكيًا في الماضي.

grammar.title: Question · السؤال
grammar.rule: Did + subject + use to + base verb?
grammar.en: Did you use to ride your bike to school?
grammar.ar: هل كنت تركب دراجتك إلى المدرسة؟

grammar.title: Short answers · الإجابة
grammar.rule: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
grammar.en: Yes, I did. No, I didn’t.
grammar.ar: بعد did أو didn’t نكتب use بدون d. وبعد to نستخدم الفعل الأساسي.
